value.rationale: A standard, motivated dispersion statistic used to compare robustness and statistical efficiency has a previously unspecified sharp adjacent-variation perturbation budget. The result identifies the complete parity staircase and a universal MaxCut envelope for all even one-Lipschitz pairwise contrast filters. Finite witnesses and general proof make it usable for robustness of moving local statistics; it is more than a renamed scalar Lipschitz estimate.
